description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an AI agent monitoring startup as a full-stack Product Engineer. You will shape how teams identify, prioritize, and resolve production failures in AI agents, helping make these systems more reliable and easier to trust.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Turn high volumes of production signals into clear, prioritized issues for teams to address.

 - Build and improve the end-to-end workflow for detecting, triaging, alerting on, and resolving failures.

 - Integrate the product with tools such as collaboration platforms, issue trackers, code hosting services, and coding agents.

 - Develop ways for people and AI agents to work together on resolving issues.

 - Build across the full stack in TypeScript, from data ingestion and core services to user-facing product features.

 - Work directly with customers to understand problems and deliver solutions, while helping establish engineering standards.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least one year shipping production software, with a track record of building products people use and contributing beyond a narrow specialty.

 - Strong full-stack TypeScript skills, including frontend development and core services.

 - Experience building and operating AI agents in production, and familiarity with AI system failure modes and debugging agent behavior.

 - Experience with high-volume event data, data pipelines, cost-aware system design, observability, monitoring, and production debugging.

 - Ability to independently take customer problems from discovery to shipped solutions, make architectural decisions, and work comfortably with ambiguity.

 - Experience as a founder or CEO.

 - Experience with user-facing products is required; PR review automation, code quality tooling, and early-stage teams are relevant backgrounds.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Annual salary range: $120,000 to $200,000 USD. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, United States, six days per week.
